title: Misplaced Strategies — Commerce & Industry v. Bayer
shortTitle: Misplaced Strategies — Commerce & Industry v. Bayer
summary: The buyer’s purchase order includes arbitration. The seller’s form is silent on arbitration but expressly conditional and disclaims being an acceptance or confirmation. After performance and a fire, the seller invokes the buyer’s arbitration term.
notes:
Textbook problem / open questions.

Which formation route applies? Does arbitration appear among the terms on which the writings agree? Explain how a party’s drafting strategy can prevent inclusion of a term that party later wishes to enforce. The source gives the dispute and asks for the result; no answer is imported from the cited opinion.
